# GrepThink 2.0

> Team-project management for the UCSC CSE 115 software-engineering series.
> Instructors run classes and project teams; students join teams and submit
> weekly peer evaluations (TSRs); TAs schedule meetings, take attendance, and
> review TSRs. v2 of grepthink.com.

GrepThink is a single-page React app backed by a FastAPI + Supabase API. Almost
everything below /app requires an authenticated session; write actions are
role-gated (instructor / TA / student).

## Public pages
- [Home](/): product overview and sign-in entry points
- [Contact](/contact): contact form
- [Student sign-up](/studentsignup) and [Instructor sign-up](/instructorsignup)
- [Log in](/login), [Forgot password](/forgot-password)

## Core concepts
- **Class**: a course section owned by an instructor. Students join with a course code.
- **Roster**: the official class list (uploaded from a UCSC CSV) merged with who has
  actually signed up.
- **Project**: a team workspace inside a class. Project roles: owner, product owner,
  scrum master, admin, member.
- **Assignment / Module**: an instructor-created task with open/close dates — either a
  TSR round or a feedback survey.
- **TSR (Team Status Report)**: a weekly peer evaluation a student submits about each
  teammate (contribution %, positive + constructive feedback).
- **TA**: an enrolled student promoted to a class-level TA. TAs run a team's weekly
  meeting + take attendance (the "meeting TA") and/or review a team's TSRs (the
  "review TA").
- **Staffing / interest form**: students rank project preferences; instructors assign
  students to teams (manually or auto-assign).

## Acting as an agent
All write actions require a Supabase-authenticated session
(`Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`) and are role-gated. A machine-readable catalog of
the available actions — workflow id, HTTP method + endpoint, required role, and form
parameters — is published at:

- [/.well-known/grepthink-actions.json](/.well-known/grepthink-actions.json)

## Notes
- This is a university course project; data is scoped per class.
- The API base path is `/api`. Auth (sign-up, login, password reset, OAuth) is
  handled directly by Supabase from the browser.
